<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've sent a message to Brad to check on his progress. It's the only productive action I can take right now. I've done my part by providing the schedules and by double-checking the availability. Now I have to wait for his response. It's frustrating to be stuck waiting, especially with the deadline for the 6 points looming, but I can't book a meeting without a confirmed time. I'll end my session and hope for a quick reply from Brad.
